name: moveTask
spec: Reassigns a Task from its current Project to a different Project. If the Task is a RecurringTask whose endedByArchiving is true, moveTask sets endedByArchiving to false, since the archiving that caused it no longer applies once the Task belongs to a different Project, while leaving its ended state unchanged. This applies when the destination Project is not archived; what moveTask does when the destination Project is itself archived is not yet specified.
